subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011 the decadal population growth rate of India for 2001-11 is approximately ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**17.64%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Census 2011 highlights:**__ 

 __
 
• **India’s population growth rate is 17.64 percent in the decade 2001-11, the slowest rate of growth this past century, as per data put out by the registrar-general of the census.**
 
• India’s population in 2011 is estimated to be 1.21 billion, **comprising 624 million males and 587 million females.**
 
• While the** gender imbalance in the population remains.**
 
• India’s** female population grew by 18.12%** over the past decade against **17.19% for males.**
 
• India’s li**teracy rate has gone up from 64.83% in 2001 to 74.04% in 2011.**
 
• **Literates constitute 74 percent of the total population **aged seven and above.
 
• The **sex ratio,** that is the number of females per 1,000 males, has **improved to 940 from 933 a decade ago.**
 
• **The child sex ratio is 914, the lowest since independence.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

__
 
• **Census**

 
 
• Defined by the United Nations, is** “the total process of collecting, compiling, evaluating, analysing and publishing or otherwise disseminating demographic, economic and social data pertaining, at a specified time, to all persons in a country or a well-defined part of the country”.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** first synchronous census** was taken under British rule on **February 17, 1881, by W.C. Plowden **(Census Commissioner of India).
 
• It has been** conducted by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner **of India.
 
• **Shri Vivek Joshi **is the **present Registrar General and Census Commissioner, Ministry of Home Affairs.**

2c
